data:
从这片土地被探险者发现起，这里一直在发生同样的事：失去所谓的“无用之物”，得到短暂繁荣，等待夜晚降临——夜里的蝴蝶不会带来厄运，但赤金可以。
<@rolv.rem>场地中有喷出气流的<源石流发生装置></>
所有敌方单位的攻击力、防御力，生命值提升至130%
敵全員の攻撃力+30%、防御力+30%、最大HP+30%
All enemy units have +30% ATK, +30% DEF, +30% Max HP

Blows out an airflow towards the 3 frontal tiles; Operators deployed <@ba.vup>downstream</>/<@ba.vdown>upstream</> from the airflow have <@ba.vup>increased</>/<@ba.vdown>decreased</> ATK; Enemies moving <@ba.vdown>downstream</>/<@ba.vup>upstream</> from the airflow have <@ba.vdown>increased</>/<@ba.vup>decreased</> Movement Speed
